info.title: Knowledge graph L3: CQL File API
info.description: A .cql file on disk, as opposed to the FHIR Library resource that wraps it. A node so that the mapping table's four CQL rows -- CQL Concepts and CQL Data Elements under Elements, CQL under Decision Tables, CQL IndicatorLogic under Indicators -- do not dead-end. It carries a name, a path and a hash and NOTHING about the logic: no expressions, no comment tags, no data requirements. 279 in the immunizations IG. The l3-cql subgraph is where that content belongs, and it is not built yet. No canonical, because a .cql file is not a FHIR resource and has no canonical URL. It is reached through the Library that wraps it. Class IRI: http://smart.who.int/kg/cql-library.
